target_customer: Developers and companies building products on AI agents who do not want to run agent infrastructure
problem: Running production agents requires sandboxes, browsers, tool management and long running execution that most teams do not want to build.
business_model: usage-based API with tiers and bring your own model keys
product_category: managed agents API and agent infrastructure

founders.name: Aditya Asgaonkar
founders.background_notes: YC page says he previously helped build Ethereum's distributed system and built agent harnesses for the past year; no employer named.

competitors.name: Claude Managed Agents (Anthropic)
competitors.what: hosted agent harness with sandboxing, state and tool execution, tied to Claude models

technical_complexity.rationale: Isolated sandboxes, browser, durable execution traces and thousands of tools through deferred discovery is solid infrastructure work for one person.

defensibility.rationale: Model labs ship the same primitive and model agnostic wrappers can be copied; the only angle is working with any model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Anthropic launched Claude Managed Agents in public beta April 2026, just before the Summer 2026 batch.

market_need_then: Agent builders needed hosted infrastructure; the launch of Anthropic's managed agents shows labs saw the same need in April 2026.

identity.logo: Click wordmark with a thin outline cursor icon

rebrands.from: earlier Click products (AI cursor style tool per Dealroom, unverified)
rebrands.why: A Product Hunt commenter noted a repositioning; this is the third Product Hunt launch.

branding.community_and_virality: Third Product Hunt launch under the Click name.

brand_strength.rationale: Very generic name shared with many companies (Clicks, ClickUp, others); no brand coverage.

pivots.from: earlier Click product, possibly an AI cursor tool
pivots.why: Not stated; Product Hunt commenter noted repositioning (unverified).

outcome_analysis: Click is a one person Summer 2026 YC company selling a model agnostic managed agents API, launched shortly after Anthropic shipped a managed agents product. It is too early for an outcome. The main risk is that model labs absorb the wedge, while bring your own key flexibility is the differentiator.
notes: Funding: EveryDev lists a 2026 seed with Y Combinator, Gradient Ventures and Stage 2 Capital without an amount; Dealroom lists a $125k seed for click_8 with an older product description. Both are single aggregators, unverified, and not recorded as rounds. The company site shows an NVIDIA Inception badge. Clicks (YC F25) is a different company. Only one dated competitor was found.
